archaeology.mechanism: Broad historical decay may leave a small operational niche identifiable from negative knowledge without replaying spent windows.
archaeology.claim: The synthetic negative-knowledge map identifies one distinct unspent niche worth freezing for later test design.
archaeology.falsification_scope: Only the synthetic legacy map and explicitly unspent niche label.

economic_expression.direction_exposure_semantics: normalized long/short exposure from the declared liquidity-reversal signal
economic_expression.entry_clock: first eligible open strictly after signal information is available
economic_expression.eligibility: security belongs to the frozen point-in-time universe and has all required signal inputs
economic_expression.position_expression: one normalized unit per eligible side; no sizing or optimization
economic_expression.cost_model_requirements: fees, spread, slippage and financing assumptions declared before test
economic_expression.capacity_requirements: observable point-in-time liquidity proxy sufficient to reject unobservable capacity
economic_expression.data_requirements: point-in-time universe, signal inputs and execution clocks
economic_expression.execution_assumptions: declared open-clock proxy only; no live order semantics
economic_expression.falsification_relevant_implementation_co: reject if PIT membership, signal clock, execution clock, costs or capacity cannot be reconstructed
